# environment at location

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:environmentAtLocation`](gmeow-environmentAtLocation.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/environmentAtLocation>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/sensory-environment`](../../slices/sensory-environment.md)

The location whose ambient conditions this [`SensoryEnvironment`](../classes/gmeow-SensoryEnvironment.md) describes. Functional: a [`SensoryEnvironment`](../classes/gmeow-SensoryEnvironment.md) concerns exactly one location (constitutive of its identity).
